exercises.question: Which sentence expresses a regular habit with soler? [¿Cuál expresa un hábito regular con soler?]
options: Suelo caminar después de cenar. [I usually walk after dinner.]
Caminé después de cenar ayer. [I walked after dinner yesterday.]
Caminaré después de cenar mañana. [I will walk after dinner tomorrow.]

exercises.sentence: Suelo __ después de cenar porque me ayuda a dormir. [I usually walk after dinner because it helps me sleep.] (caminar)

exercises.english: At weekends we usually cook at home.

sentences: Normalmente preparo la cena en casa. [I normally prepare dinner at home.]
Después de cenar, suelo caminar. [After dinner, I usually walk.]
Así duermo mejor por la noche. [That way I sleep better at night.]

exercises.question: Which sentence correctly uses soler with nosotros? [¿Cuál usa correctamente soler con nosotros?]
options: Solemos cocinar en casa. [We usually cook at home.]
Solimos cocinar en casa. [We usually cook at home.]
Suelen cocinar en casa. [They usually cook at home.]

exercises.sentence: Los fines de semana __ cocinar en casa. [At weekends we usually cook at home.] (soler)

exercises.english: I avoid habits that can be harmful to my health.

exercises.sentence: Suelo caminar después de cenar porque me ayuda a dormir.
options: I usually walk after dinner because it helps me sleep.
I walked after dinner yesterday because I was tired.
I will walk after dinner because I want to exercise tomorrow.

exercises.sentence: Los fines de semana solemos cocinar en casa.
options: At weekends we usually cook at home.
At weekends we cooked at home once.
At weekends we are going to eat in a restaurant.

exercises.sentence: Normalmente duermo siete horas, aunque durante los viajes duermo menos.

template.answer: Suelo caminar después de cenar porque me ayuda a dormir mejor.

template.answer: Quiero cambiar el hábito de dormir poco porque puede resultar perjudicial para mi salud.
